pages.title: Ejecta Ore
pages.text: Scorched nuggets blown out of a white hole. They are rich in elements that should not exist together, flung up from a region that admits no entry. The surfaces are glassy from the violence of their exit.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The ejecta rock is peppered with dense, blistered lumps. I first took them for meteorites until I traced their trajectories back to a point nothing can enter.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the white hole interior (mine it for its drop).
